definitions.core_principle: For every lagna, Saturn in any sign can give yoga OR dosha. Textbook house-by-house Saturn results (late marriage in 7th, no children in 5th, ruin in 8th, etc.) are only defaults; the deciding factors are sthana bala (positional strength), retrogression, the dispositor's strength, Jupiter and Rahu/Ketu links, the star lord, and whether Saturn's dasa runs in the relevant life window.
definitions.sthana_bala_ok: Saturn own/exalted, OR retrograde while debilitated (neecha + vakra = uccha result), OR its dispositor own/exalted (neecha-bhanga)
definitions.retro_rule: Retrograde Saturn in own/exalted sign loses sthana bala ('a stage king who is not a real king') -> dosha, UNLESS rescued.
definitions.rescuers: Jupiter aspect/conjunction/exchange (from anywhere), OR Rahu/Ketu conjunction/aspect/star link. Either converts a retrograde or weak Saturn's dasa into yoga.
definitions.conflicting_authorities: When sign lord and star lord pull opposite ways, judge by the STRONGER of the two.
definitions.dasa_gate: If Saturn dasa ran in infancy/childhood or arrives very late (e.g. 80s), the marriage/career effects never manifest - mark dormant.
definitions.caution: One missed factor flips a yoga reading into its opposite; the advice can be worth lakhs or crores to the client, so check twice.

rules.name: Classical verse - default negative
rules.result: Old verse: Saturn in 12,7,8,9,10,5,4,2,1 harms wealth/marriage. Treat as default only - always override with the factors below.

rules.name: Meena lagna: Saturn in Lagna (lord_11 + lord_12)

branches.then: Yoga - lord_11 in lagna, lord_12 in lagna both favourable; Saturn dasa prosperous
Saturn dasa drains income, wealth and property
Saturn dasa and the node's dasa both become yoga

rules.name: Meena lagna: Saturn own sign in 12th (Kumbha)

branches.then: Strong 12th lord - property, house, vehicles, children, name and money in Saturn dasa

branches.if: retrograde with Jupiter or Rahu/Ketu link

rules.note: Speaker: Saturn in Sathayam (Rahu's star) also works well in practice.

rules.name: Meena lagna: Saturn own sign in 11th (Makara)

branches.then: Large earnings, employs others, small business grows big; leaves substantial assets behind
Saturn dasa in earning years is very hard

rules.name: Meena lagna: Saturn in 10th (Dhanus)

branches.if: dispositor Jupiter strong (e.g. exalted in Kataka, direct)
branches.then: Own business, big success; out-earns father and grandfather; engineering, services, supply chain, production; others earn for him

branches.if: Jupiter retrograde in Kataka (acts debilitated) without Rahu
branches.then: Unstable career; can't hold a job; steep fall

branches.if: Jupiter retrograde in Kataka WITH Rahu

rules.general: Malefics in the 10th / kendras are acceptable.

rules.name: Conflicting sign lord vs star lord
rules.example: Saturn in Dhanus in Pooradam (Venus star) with Venus debilitated but Jupiter exalted -> judge by Jupiter (stronger) -> yoga.

rules.name: Saturn (or Sun/Mars) in 9th
rules.default: Classical: hard for the father, pitru dosha, but for the native, wealth, defeats enemies.

branches.if: dispositor debilitated (e.g. Mars in Kataka for Saturn in Vrischika)
branches.then: Reverses: father prospers; native faces opposition, slow earnings, leaves native place/family trade

rules.sensitivity: father-related output: show gently, not as a prediction about the father's life

branches.if: with Rahu, no neecha-bhanga, not retrograde
branches.then: Saturn/Rahu dasa delays marriage, family discord

branches.if: no rescue at all BUT Saturn dasa only in childhood or very late

rules.name: Retrograde Saturn in 2nd (Simha lagna)
rules.result: Yoga - weakened malefic (viparita logic). Direct Saturn there is the problem case.

rules.name: Saturn in 12th, own sign, direct (Kumbha lagna)
rules.result: Winning dasa - yoga as long as Saturn is not retrograde.

rules.name: Saturn as lord_7 exalted in 4th (Kataka lagna)
rules.result: Marriage is assured, even during Saturn dasa.

rules.name: Saturn + Jupiter in 2nd (Mesha lagna)
rules.result: Excellent Saturn dasa if Venus strong (best if exalted); mild wobble if Venus retrograde/debilitated. Saturn-Jupiter natives are calm and measured.

rules.name: Stellium in 10th
rules.result: Three planets in 10th incl. own-sign 10th lord (e.g. Saturn+Mars+Venus in Makara for Mesha) = wealth. Four or more in 10th can work like sanyasa yoga - check further.

rules.name: Rahu in 2nd or 8th
rules.result: Textbook loss/late marriage, but can equally give early marriage or crorepati status when rescued - same yoga/dosha logic as Saturn.

rules.name: Astrology aptitude
rules.condition: any of: Mercury in kendra/trikona; Jupiter in or aspecting lagna; Saturn or Rahu/Ketu linked to 2nd
rules.result: Interest/aptitude for astrology (professional success needs more).

rules.name: Transit Jupiter over natal Jupiter
rules.result: Wealth, respect, status, health - only if natal Jupiter is direct.

excluded_from_engine: Remarks on science vs astrology, Sade-sati debate - commentary only
open_questions_for_implementation: Most rules are worked for Meena lagna - generalise to all lagnas via lordship (lord_11/lord_12 in lagna, own-sign Saturn in 10/11/12, debilitated Saturn in 2nd etc.)
Order of rescuer precedence when several apply
Retrograde-in-debilitation = exalted: confirm it applies uniformly with the retrograde_planets ruleset
